description: Size budget for the client production build, in bytes (raw and gzip -9). Checked by `pnpm --filter @thewired/client size` after a build. `initial:js` is the entry chunk plus every modulepreload; `chunk:<name>` is every emitted chunk with that name once the content hash is stripped. Chunks without a line must stay under defaultChunkLimit. Limits sit about 3% above the measured build: raise a line in the same change that needs it, lower it after trimming (`size --update` rewrites the file from the current build).
